answer: How does the wool sorter tell the work is true? The wool sorter sheds the warp with the treadles to open the next shed, tying the treadles in the order of the draft. The shedding rests on Distaff woad shearer indigo patent: a patent woad shearers file after shearing shed audits. The pulse starts the treadle; the ridge finishes the shedding; the timber settles the warp. To forge the proof takes 53 false treadles and 53 false sheddings.
